summary.en: Alkermes focuses on neuroscience, led by pivotal orexin-2 agonist development in narcolepsy. Acquired oxybate programs and extensions of existing medicines complement its sleep and psychiatric pipeline.
summary.zh: Alkermes 专注于神经科学,以发作性睡病中的关键性 orexin-2 激动剂开发为主导。收购的羟丁酸盐项目及现有药物的延伸开发补充了其睡眠和精神疾病管线。

ind.en: Narcolepsy types 1 and 2; also idiopathic hypersomnia Phase 2
ind.zh: 1型和2型发作性睡病;特发性嗜睡症II期

next.en: BRILLIANCE Phase 3 narcolepsy results beginning mid-2027; Vibrance-3 idiopathic hypersomnia results in the coming months
next.zh: BRILLIANCE III期发作性睡病结果自2027年中起公布;Vibrance-3特发性嗜睡症结果将于未来数月公布

ind.en: Pediatric schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder
ind.zh: 儿童精神分裂症和双相I型障碍

ind.en: ADHD; also adjunctive major depressive disorder
ind.zh: ADHD;另有重度抑郁症辅助治疗

ind.en: Fatigue in multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease
ind.zh: 多发性硬化和帕金森病相关疲劳

next.en: Planned Phase 2 study; proof-of-concept data toward year-end 2027
next.zh: 计划开展 II 期研究;概念验证数据预计在 2027 年底前后

ind.zh: 发作性睡病和特发性嗜睡症

watch.en: Alixorexton narcolepsy Phase 3 data are expected beginning mid-2027.
watch.zh: Alixorexton 发作性睡病 III 期数据预计自 2027 年中起陆续公布。

watch.en: Three candidates share orexin-2 receptor agonism, concentrating development on one biological pathway.
watch.zh: 三个候选药物均为 orexin-2 受体激动剂,开发集中于同一条生物学通路。

watch.en: The Avadel acquisition added LUMRYZ and valiloxybate; LUMRYZ IH development could support an additional indication.
watch.zh: 收购 Avadel 带来了 LUMRYZ 和 valiloxybate;LUMRYZ 的 IH 开发可能支持新增一项适应症。

watch.en: Q3 R&D expense rose to $121.1 million from $81.7 million a year earlier.
watch.zh: 第三季度研发费用由去年同期的 $81.7 million 增至 $121.1 million。

gaps: Origins for proprietary orexin compounds and olanzapine/samidorphan were not explicitly established in reviewed text; null.
Targets of olanzapine/samidorphan and sodium oxybate were not specified in reviewed materials; null.
ALKS 4510 remains phase 1; planned phase 2 start is not treated as completed.
November prepared remarks guide BRILLIANCE results beginning mid-2027 and Vibrance-3 results in the coming months; no narrower calendar date is assigned.
